firmware.requirements: PAL A500, 68000, OCS 8371/8362, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow RAM, one DD/HD drive; read-only DF0 floppy boot or an owned writable CopperOS DOS1 workspace. Optional existing hard disk image on unit 0: RDB-discovered FFS/DOS1 partitions or one explicit 512-byte FFS partition, including TD64 offsets above 4 GiB. RDB boot priorities select SYS:. No RTC, Fast RAM or shared folders.

SFS recovery follows the native SFS-write profile. Core 493924 bytes; graphics 30099 bytes at $FF8A00. No NSD changes.

sources.scope: Relevant update-procedure sources retained after build. Exact installed binary hashes are authoritative; baseline source evidence remains with the earlier installed qualification.
